description: Sync the SurveyMonkey surveys you choose: each survey's questionnaire, and each response as question and answer pairs linked to its survey.
opening: Sync the SurveyMonkey surveys you select. Each survey is one document with its page text and question wording. Each response is one document of question and answer pairs, linked to its survey. A respondent who gave an email is attached to the response as a person.

SurveyMonkey team sharing is not imported, so every synced survey and response is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. On SurveyMonkey Basic plans, only 25 responses per survey come through. Surveys and responses deleted in SurveyMonkey stay in HydraDB.

notes: Every synced survey and response carries a fixed `additional_metadata.rbac_warning` note saying SurveyMonkey sharing is not captured. The note does not decide who can read the item. An access rule you set still applies.

connect.auth: SurveyMonkey uses an app access token.

credentials.name: access_token
credentials.text: The access token of a SurveyMonkey app with the scopes below.

permissions.name: surveys_read
permissions.text: View Surveys, to list surveys and read their pages and questions.

permissions.name: responses_read_detail
permissions.text: View Response Details, to read responses with readable answers.

steps.title: Create a SurveyMonkey app
steps.text: Create an app in SurveyMonkey and give its token View Surveys and View Response Details. A draft app's token expires after 90 days unless you deploy the app. Replace the token in the connector before then.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the app's access token as `access_token`.

steps.title: Select surveys
steps.text: HydraDB lists the surveys the token can see, by title. Only the first 100 surveys are listed. Select the surveys to sync. Each one syncs separately.

connect.account: One connector reads the surveys one SurveyMonkey token can see.

sync.first_sync: Reaches back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default, by when each survey and response was last modified, or created if there is no modification time.
sync.changes: Each sync reads the questionnaires and responses of each selected survey that were modified in its window.
sync.edits: A modified questionnaire or response replaces its document. A questionnaire last modified before the window is not read, even while its new responses sync.
sync.deletes: Deleted surveys and responses are not removed. A survey or response deleted in SurveyMonkey stays searchable in HydraDB.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.surveymonkey_id
shared_attributes.text: The SurveyMonkey id of the survey or response. Targets one item. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.rbac_warning
shared_attributes.text: A fixed note that SurveyMonkey sharing is not captured. It does not decide who can read the item. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: stream_type
shared_attributes.text: The record type, `survey_details` or `simplified_responses`, shown when you inspect the item.

documents.name: Surveys
documents.title: The survey title, else its nickname, else `SurveyMonkey survey <id>`.
documents.text: The nickname when it differs from the title, then each page's title and description and every question, one per line, in survey order. Answer choices are not part of the text. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the survey was last modified, or created if there is no modification time.
documents.link_back: The survey's preview page, else its analyze page, else its address in SurveyMonkey's API.

attributes.name: nickname
attributes.text: The survey's alternate name. It is the title when there is no survey title, and is written into the text when it differs from the title.

attributes.name: Pages and questions
attributes.text: Each page's title and description and each question's wording, in the order the survey shows them.

attributes.name: date_modified, date_created
attributes.text: When the survey was last modified and created. The modification time, else the creation time, sets the result date. Not searchable.

attributes.name: Answer choices
attributes.text: The answer choices each question offers, when SurveyMonkey supplies them. Kept for inspection only. A choice a respondent selected is searchable on their response.

attributes.name: Other survey fields
attributes.text: Other survey fields SurveyMonkey returns. Kept for inspection only.

documents.name: Responses
documents.one_document: One response to a selected survey.
documents.title: `SurveyMonkey response <response id>`. The title does not name the survey.
documents.text: The title, then `Respondent` and `Email` lines, then a `Q:` line with the question and an `A:` line with the answer for each answered question. Several answers to one question are joined with `;`. Unanswered questions are left out.
documents.date: When the response was last modified, or created if there is no modification time.
documents.link_back: The response's analyze page, else its address in SurveyMonkey's API.
documents.files: None. Only answer text is kept.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.text: The respondent's email, when the survey collected it, written as the `Email` line. It attaches the respondent to the response as a person in the graph.

attributes.name: first_name, last_name
attributes.text: The respondent's name, when collected, written as the `Respondent` line.

attributes.name: Questions and answers
attributes.text: Each answered question's wording and the readable answer text.

attributes.name: survey_id
attributes.text: The survey the response belongs to. Links the response to its survey. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.surveymonkey_survey_id
attributes.text: The survey id. Limits a query to the responses of one survey. Not searchable.

attributes.name: date_modified, date_created
attributes.text: When the response was last modified and created. The modification time, else the creation time, sets the result date. Not searchable.

attributes.name: ip_address, custom_variables, metadata, quiz_results, response_status
attributes.text: Submission details, when present: the respondent's IP address, custom variables, metadata, quiz results and response status. Kept for inspection only.

attributes.name: Other response fields
attributes.text: Other response fields SurveyMonkey returns. Kept for inspection only.

example_searches: What questions does the Q3 customer satisfaction survey ask?
What did respondents answer to "How likely are you to recommend us?" in the NPS survey?
What did jane@example.com say in their survey response?

people: The respondent of each response, identified by their email, when the survey collected it.
graph.from_text: The questionnaire text and each response's questions and answers.

not_synced: Surveys you did not select, and surveys past the first 100 listed.
Responses past 25 per survey on SurveyMonkey Basic plans.
The answer choices a question offers, in the survey's searchable text.
Deletions: surveys and responses deleted in SurveyMonkey stay in HydraDB.
